form.title: Add exam structure
form.description: An exam structure holds the parts (written, MCQ, viva…) and marks for each class and subject. Add them after creating it.
form.errorNameTooLong: Name can be at most {{max}} characters.
form.errorDuplicate: Another exam structure already has this name.

list.title: Exam structures
list.caption: Exam structures
list.subtitle: Set the parts and marks of each class and subject once; pick the structure when you create an exam.
list.emptyText: Use a ready-made curriculum or add a new one.

delete.title: Delete this exam structure?
delete.description: “{{name}}” and all its parts will be deleted. Exams already created from it do not change.

detail.leaveText: Your changes to this exam structure are not saved yet and will be lost.
detail.noGradesText: Add a class, then its subjects and parts.

error.nameTooLong: Name can be at most {{max}} characters.
error.nameDuplicate: Two parts of this subject share a name.
error.fullInvalid: Full marks must be above 0 and at most {{max}}, with up to 2 decimals.
error.passInvalid: Pass marks must be between 0 and full marks, with up to 2 decimals.
error.attendanceDuplicate: Only one Attendance part is allowed per subject.
error.noComponents: Add at least one part, or remove this subject.
error.gradeInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 99.
error.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.

grid.intro: {{n}} subjects in class {{grade}} · enter full and pass marks for each part. Press “Save” at the top when done.

help.templateName: E.g. Half-yearly; at most 200 characters. Two structures cannot share a name.
help.grade: 1 to 99, e.g. 9. The structure is matched to the class grade.
help.subject: One of the school subjects. Exams match it by subject code.
help.partName: E.g. Written; two parts of one subject cannot share a name.
help.partKind: Written, MCQ, viva and so on. Only one attendance part per subject.
help.fullMarks: More than 0, at most 9999.99, up to 2 decimal places.
help.passMarks: From 0 to the full marks, up to 2 decimal places.
